subject: Post-demo: MediCloud long-context fit, truncation & regression action plan
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Ellie Moreno <ellie@medicloud.health>, MediCloud EngOps <engops@medicloud.health>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: MediCloud long-context fit, truncation & regression action plan

Hi Ellie / EngOps team —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our side + an actionable plan to validate model fit for your long visit histories:

What we heard:
- Primary need: reliable visit-history summarization for care teams across 10–30k token patient records.
- Concern: truncation in 8k/16k variants leads to missing diagnosis details and occasionally incorrect problem-lists.
- Security: PHI must be masked for benchmarking; SOC2 evidence requested.

Proposed evaluation scope (short):
1) Baseline models: run Redwood-verified 32k variant (redwood-instruct-xl-32k) and a 16k quantized candidate (redwood-quant-eff-16k) to compare truncation behavior and token cost.
2) Prompt & metrics: use the attached prompt-suite-v1.md (50 representative long visit notes + label schema). Measure ROUGE / BERTScore / hallucination rate (human spot-check) and fidelity on problem-list extraction.
3) Regression checks: run the same prompts on your current in-prod model outputs to surface fidelity regressions.
4) Cost/runtime: we’ll capture per-request token cost and 95th percentile latency with 4 concurrent users to mimic triage flows.

Deliverables: a short report (PDF) with sample failure cases, cost delta for 1000 patient summaries, recommended fallback policy (prefix caching + two-shot summary) and a suggested rollout canary.

Attachments included: prompt-suite-v1.md, bench-config.yaml, sample-long-docs.zip. I can also share a SOC2 summary if you need that before we run masked tests.

Next steps I suggest:
- Your approval to run the masked evaluation on a small sample (50 records) — we will not touch raw PHI (we will use redaction/masking steps documented).
- Tentative 1-week run: start Mon Jun 21 — deliver results Fri Jun 25.
- Optional: quick check-in Wed Jun 23 to preview early failure modes.

If that timeline works I’ll schedule the run and share the benchmark link + cost estimate.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

---
Attachments: prompt-suite-v1.md, bench-config.yaml, sample-long-docs.zip
From: Ellie Moreno <ellie@medicloud.health>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Cc: MediCloud EngOps <engops@medicloud.health>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: MediCloud long-context fit, truncation & regression action plan

Rishi —

Thanks for the clear plan. A few things before we greenlight a run:
1) PHI handling: we cannot send unmasked PHI. Will you run the benchmark on a dataset we export with tokens replaced (masking per our DLP rules)? Or do you need to run on our infra?
2) SOC2 evidence: can you attach the SOC2 summary + any encryption/KMS details? Our security team will need that before any data movement.
3) Cost: high-level estimate for 1k summaries (production pattern) so finance can pre-approve an evaluation budget.

Also cc’ing EngOps — please include our security contact (security@medicloud.health) on any SOC2 docs.

Ellie
Director, Product
MediCloud Health
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Ellie Moreno <ellie@medicloud.health>, MediCloud EngOps <engops@medicloud.health>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 08:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: MediCloud long-context fit, truncation & regression action plan

Ellie — appreciate the questions. Short answers and an internal-run plan: 

PHI handling: we can do both. Preferred: you provide a masked export (we’ll provide a masking script) and we run the eval in our private test tenancy (no raw PHI leaves your environment). Alternative: we provide a test package you run in your VPC (Redwood Private) with our bench config. Which is easiest for you?

SOC2 & security: attaching a redacted SOC2-summary-redacted.pdf and a short note on KMS/HSM options. We will grant your security team read-only access to the benchmark Drive folder and results.

Model recommendations & calibration plan: 
- Step A (smoke): redwood-instruct-xl-32k (baseline) + redwood-quant-eff-16k (cost-efficient candidate) on sample of 50 masked records.
- Step B (stress): run larger 500-record job to exercise long-tail token counts and prefix caching.
- Metrics: ROUGE-L, BERTScore, token retention (% of diagnostic tokens preserved), and manual 10-case fidelity audit for hallucinations.
- Summarization fidelity checks: compare extracted problem-list against ground truth; flag where any critical diagnosis (ICD-like code) is dropped or changed.

Rough cost estimate (eval run only):
- 50-record smoke run (avg 18k tokens per record): ~ $120 (hosted)
- 500-record stress run: ~ $1,200 (hosted)
(These are rough; I’ll provide exact per-token math in the report.)

Attachments: SOC2-summary-redacted.pdf (attached), bench-config.yaml (attached).

Proposed scheduling: we can start with a masked 50-record run next week (Mon Jun 21). If you prefer the VPC route, we can target the week after.

If you’re ok with the masked-run approach, Neha will coordinate data handoff and security access.

Best,
Rishi

---
Attachments: SOC2-summary-redacted.pdf, bench-config.yaml

Subject: Re: Post-demo: MediCloud long-context fit, truncation & regression action plan

Ellie — looping in to coordinate. Happy to run the masked evaluation in our private test tenancy (we will only use the masked files you provide). I’ll share the masking script and an upload link.

Proposed slots for the 50-record run start:
- Mon Jun 21 10:00 PT (preferred)
- Tue Jun 22 14:00 PT

Security: we will add security@medicloud.health as a Drive viewer and provide the SOC2 redacted doc Rishi attached. For the VPC option, I’ve included Aditya to scope agent access and estimated setup time (~2 business days).

Action items I will take this week:
- Share masking script + upload instructions (today)
- Create benchmark run plan in our Drive and grant read access to your security contact
- Prepare cost breakdown (line-item per model) and share before the run

If that works, give a thumbs-up and we’ll lock the slot.

Thanks — Neha
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Ellie Moreno <ellie@medicloud.health>

Neha / Rishi —

Thanks — that approach looks good. We’ll prepare a masked export (using your script) and share the upload link by EOD Fri Jun 18. Please include estimated per-1k-summary cost when you send the breakdown (finance asked for that). Also confirm that the masked files will never be re-identified and that results will only be shared with the viewers we list.

Assume we’re greenlit for Mon Jun 21 10:00 PT unless we hear otherwise.

Ellie
